versions.subject: Update posh_ps_wmi_unquoted_service_search.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Get-WmiObject '
        - 'gwmi '
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - ' Win32_Service '
        - 'Name'
        - 'DisplayName'
        - 'PathName'
        - 'StartMode'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*Get-WmiObject *", "*gwmi *") ScriptBlockText="* Win32_Service *" ScriptBlockText="*Name*" ScriptBlockText="*DisplayName*" ScriptBlockText="*PathName*" ScriptBlockText="*StartMode*"
